questions.question: A man bought three articles for Rs. 3,000 each. He sold the articles respectively at 15% profit, 10% profit and 15% loss. The total percentage profit/loss he earned is
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

First articles C.P. = Rs. 3000

First articles S.P. = 3000 × (115/100) = Rs. 3450.

Second articles C.P. = Rs. 3000

Second articles S.P. = 3000 × (110/100) =. Rs. 3300

Third articles C.P. = Rs. 3000

Third articles S.P. = 3000 × (85/100) = Rs. 2550

Total C.P. = 3000 × 3 = Rs. 9000

Total S.P. = 3450 + 3300 + 2550 = 9300

Profit percentage = (300/9000) × 100 = 10/3%

questions.question: If x = 2 + √5 then the value of x³ + x⁻³ is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

⇒ x = 2 + √5

**Formula used:**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab (a + b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ x = √5 + 2

By componendo and dividendo

⇒ 1/x = √5 - 2 

Now,

⇒ x + 1/x = 2 + √5 + √5 - 2 = 2√5

On cubing both sides,

⇒ (x + 1/x)³ = (2√5)³

⇒ x³ + (1/x³) + 3(x + 1/x) = 40√5

⇒ x³ + (1/x³) + 3(2√5) = 40√5

⇒ x³ + (1/x³) = 40√5 − 6√5

⇒ x³ + 1/x

questions.question: If a³ – b³ = 899 and a – b = 31, then (a – b)² + 3ab is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

⇒ a3 - b3 = 899

⇒ a - b = 31

**Formula used:**

(a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

a3 - b3 = (a - b) (a2 + b2 + ab)

**Calculation:**

⇒ a³ - b³ = (a - b) × (a² + b² + ab)

⇒ a³ - b³ = (a - b) × (a² + b² + ab + 2ab - 2ab)

⇒ a³ - b³ = (a - b) × ((a² + b² - 2ab) + 3ab)

⇒ a³ - b³ = (a - b) × ((a - b)² + 3ab)

Putting the values,

⇒ (a³ - b³) / (a - b) = (a - b)² + 3ab

⇒ 899/31 = (a - b)² + 3ab

⇒ (a - b)² + 3ab = 29

**∴ The correct answer is 29.**

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral, such that AB is a diameter of the circle circumscribing it and angle ADC = 126°. ∠BAC is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral. 

∠ADC = 126°

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59e0808c48456bff588b8ab372bd34cd686b9d9f1cecc45dbc1f079e2f152d23.png] 

∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180°(sum of the opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°)

∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180°

⇒ 126° + ∠ABC = 180°

⇒ 126° + ∠ABC = 180°

⇒ ∠ABC = 180 − 126°

∠ABC = 54°

Since, ∠ACB

∠ACB is an angle in a semi–circle.

∠ACB = 90°

In ΔABC, ∠BAC + ∠ACB + ∠ABC = 180°

ΔABC, ∠BAC + ∠ACB + ∠ABC = 180° [by angle sum property of a triangle]

⇒ ∠BAC = 90° + 54° = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC = 90° + 54° = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC = 180° − 144° = 36°

**∴ The correct answer is 36°**

questions.question: If x⁴ + x⁻⁴ = 194, (x > 0), then the value of (2x – 4)² is
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x4 + x-4 = 194

**Formula used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculation:**

x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = 194 ----(1)

⇒ (x² + 1/x²)² – 2 = 194

⇒ (x² + 1/x²)² = 194 + 2

⇒ x² + 1/x² = √196

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 14 ----(2)

⇒ (x + 1/x)² – 2 = 14

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 14 + 2

⇒ (x + 1/x) = √16

⇒ x + 1/x = 4

⇒ x² + 1 = 4x

⇒ x² – 4x = –1 ----(3)

We have to find the value of (2x – 4)²

4 (x – 2)²

⇒ 4 (x² – 4x + 4)

⇒ 4 (–1 + 4), from (3)

⇒ 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__****Concept used:**

⇒ x4 + 1/x4 = p

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = √{p + 2} 

**Calculation:**

According to the question:

⇒ x4 + x-4 = 194

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = √{194 + 2}

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 14

Now, 

⇒ x + 1/x = √{14 + 2}

⇒ x + 1/x = √16 = 4

⇒ x² + 1 = 4x

⇒ x2 + 4x = - 1 ------(1)

So, (2x – 4)2 = (2)² (x - 2)²

⇒ 4 (x – 2)2

⇒ 4 (x2 – 4x + 4)

⇒ 4 (–1 + 4), from (1)

⇒ 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

questions.question: A dealer buys an article marked at Rs. 30000 with two successive discounts of 20% and 5%. He spends Rs. 1200 on repairs and sells it for Rs. 30000, what is his profit/loss percent?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

C.P of article = marked price × 80% × 95%

So, C.P of article = 30000 × 4/5 × 19/20 = 22800

Additional expenditure = 1200 

So, total C.P of article = 22800 + 1200 = 24000

Given that S.P of article = 30000

So, gain = 30000 – 24000 = 6000

Gain% = (gain /C.P) × 100

Gain% = (6000/24000) × 100 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

questions.question: The average age of fifteen person is 32 years. If two more persons are added then the average is increased by 3 years. The new person have an age difference of 9 years between them. The age (in years) of the younger among the new persons is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average age of 15 person is 32 years.

**Formula used: **

Average age = sum of ages of all persons/number of persons

**Calculation:**

Sum of ages of 15 persons = average age × 15

Sum of ages of 15 persons = 32 × 15 = 480

Let the ages of two persons are x and y

According to question,

Average age of 17 persons = 32 + 3 = 35

So, the sum of ages of 17 persons = 17 × 35 = 595

According to the question:

Sum of ages of 15 person + x + y = sum of ages of 17 persons 

⇒ 480 + x + y = 595

⇒ x + y = 595 – 480

⇒ x + y = 115 ----(1)

It is given that their age difference is 9 years 

⇒ x – y = 9 ----(2)

On subtracting (2) from (1) we get

⇒ y = 53

**∴ The age of younger person = 53 years**

questions.question:
The given Bar Graph presents the results in terms of the number of students in a school for the five academic years, 2013–2014 to 2017–2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f1b261461ca8ac52b652dbdf323357cde72f1558153e0bd88ad4a0c19d1eb04.png] 

In which year the percentage increase in total number of passed students is the lowest in comparison to its previous academic year?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

For year 2014–2015, percentage increase of passed students as compared to previous year = (200 – 150)/150 × 100 = 33.33%

For year 2015–2016, percentage increase of passed students as compared to previous year = (300 – 200)/200 × 100 = 50%

For year 2016-2017 percentage increase of passed students as compared to previous year = (250-300)/300 × 100 = -16.66%

(Negative sign means there is decrease in percentage of passed students in 2016-2017 in comparison to 2015 -2016)

For year 2017–2018, percentage increase of passed students as compared to previous year = (300 – 250)/250 × 100 = 20%

**∴ For the year 2017–2018, the percentage increase in a total number of passed students is the lowest in comparison to its previous academic year.**

questions.question: The sum of the salaries of A and B is Rs. 42,000. A spends 75% of his salary and B spends 90% of his salary. Now their savings are the same. What is B’s salary (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum of the salaries of A and B is Rs. 42,000.

**Calculation:**

A spends 75% of his salary, his saving 25% of his salary

B spends 90% of his salary, his saving 10% of his salary

According to condition,

Saving of A = saving of B

⇒ 25% A = 10% B

⇒ A : B = 2 : 5

Now salary of B = (5/7) × 42,000 = 5 × 6, 000 = 30,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.30000.**

questions.question: A and B can complete a piece of work in 15 days and 10 days respectively. They got a contract to complete the work for Rs. 75000. The share of A (in Rs.) in the contracted money will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can complete a piece of work in 15 days.

B can complete a piece of work in 10 days.

**Calculation:**

Ratio of number of days taken by A and B to complete the work = 15 : 10 = 3 : 2

Ratio of efficiency of A and B = 2 : 3

Let their share is in the ratio of 2x and 3x

Now

⇒ 2x + 3x = 75000

⇒ 5x = 75000

⇒ x = 15000

Share of A = 2x = 15000 × 2 = Rs. 30000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 30000.**

questions.question: In ΔABC, ∠A = 52°. Its side AB and AC are produced to the points D and E respectively. If the bisectors of the ∠CBD and ∠BCE meet at point O, then ∠BOC is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠BAC = 52°

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b0c2d22810f7c264371e0a074aba52d49a12ab114de245d73e0a01106bc4daf.png] 

⇒ ∠BOC = 90° - ∠A/2

⇒ ∠BOC = 90° - (52°/2)

⇒ ∠BOC = 90° - 26°

⇒ ∠BOC = 64°

**∴ The correct answer is 64°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

∠A = 52°

**Calculation:**

∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

52° + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

∠B + ∠C = 128°

Let ∠B = x° , ∠C = y°

Now, 

AB is extended to D, 

∠ABD = 180°

∠ABD = ∠ABC + ∠DBC = 180°

x + ∠DBC = 180° 

∠DBC = (180° - x)

Similarly, 

∠ECB = (180° - y)

Now,

As per the triangle Law,

frac{{angle ECB}}{2} + frac{{angle DBC}}{2} + angle O = {180^ circ }

frac{{{{180}^ circ } - x}}{2} + frac{{{{180}^ circ } - y}}{2} + angle O = {180^ circ }

{180^ circ } - (x)/(2) - (y)/(2) + angle O = {180^ circ }

angle O = frac{{x + y}}{2} = frac{{{{128}^ circ }}}{2} = {64^ circ }

∴ The correct answer is 64°.

questions.question: If the seven digit number 64x29y6 (x > y) is divisible by 72, what is the value of (2x – 3y)?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ 72 = 9 × 8, where 9 and 8 are co–prime

⇒ 64x29y6 is should be divisible by 9 and 8

Divisibility rule of 8,

⇒ Last three digits 9y6 so minimum value of y = 3

Divisibility rule of 9,

⇒ 30 + x also divisible by 9 so x = 6

The value of (2x – 3y) = 12 – 9 = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**
